title: Kushner, Iger Buy Lakers for Record-Breaking $12.5 Billion
summary: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger are buying the Los Angeles Lakers basketball team for a record-breaking price of $12.5 billion, according to people familiar with the matter. Randall Williams has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Indonesian Tech Firm GoTo Cut From MSCI Indexes in Review
summary: MSCI Inc. removed GoTo Group from its indexes after a plunge in the Indonesian tech company’s share price left the stock difficult to trade.

title: Singer Vehicle Founder on Louis Vuitton Partnership
summary: In a groundbreaking collaboration, luxury fashion house Louis Vuitton and high-end automotive restoration company Singer have teamed up to create custom Porsche cars. This marks a first for both brands, as Louis Vuitton has never engaged in co-branding before, and Singer has not previously partnered on such a project. Rob Dickinson & Mazen Fawaz speak with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Former CDC Official on the Cyclospora Outbreak
